main_text.p: mulacrum Dei Deum nuncupant. Item Conrad. Brun. de i-mag.cap.17.colum-bæ imago die Pentecostes in Medio templi super-nè demittitur, & mox cum ea ignis & aqua decidit cum sonitu quodam, qualis bombardarum esse solet, sacerdote canente: Accipite Spiritum sanctum. Quo ludo quum A&.2.1.historiam in Apostolo-rum actis scriptam exprimant; prorsus ut in Dominica Pentecostes.Missalibus Breviar.& offic.B.Ma-riæ Virg.similibúsque libris pingunt, aqua excepta, quæ Ioh.7.38.aliunde adscita est, & sonitu bom-bardarum, qui in pictúram non cadit: imaginem Spiritus sancti, per impiam & profanam ad Chri-sti verba allusionem, Spiritum sanctum vocant. Quid? In Iapan insula, Io.Fernand. Iesuit. epist. Iapan.18.quum Icsuitarum disci-puli spectaculum noste natalis Domini exhibe-rent, in quo Adam & Eva, seduɛti à serpente, e-jecti è paradiso, vestibus, quas Deus iis ministra-verat, induti repræsentabantur: nonne qui Deum egit, vocabatur Deus? Aut, si Deus ibi non est introductus in theatrum seu templum; (nam isti templa sua in theatra vertunt, & sanctum Dei verbum in ludicras fabulas transformant:) nonne in spectaculo, quo festum Corporis Christi se honorasse gloriatur Papa Lib.8.commentariorum, Quos ab ipso scriptos testatur Platina in Pio II.Pius secundus, aula regis cœlestis expressa memoratur, & sedens in maiestate Deus? Virginémque Matrem è sepulcro assumtam æterno Patri Filius obtulisse dicitur? Ergo & histrio, personam ac imaginem Dei Patris referens, Deus æternúsque Pater appellatur stylo Papali. Denique, Sacrar.ceremoniar.Ec-clef. Roman. lib.1.tit.7.{h}Pontifices, sacro & solenni religionis ritu, nomen 1.Pet.1.19.immaculati agni, hoc est, Act.20.28.Dei, qui Ecclesiam sanguine suo acquisivit, si-mulacris ejus indere consueverunt. Nam solenni-bus precibus, quibus cereas agni imagunculas con-secrant, implorant Deum Patrem, ut isti agni

page.notes: The scan is at a slight angle and the page edge is shadowed; the text is clear. The note markers are small and some are doubtful: the mark before "Papa" reads like "s" and was taken as the note "g"; the mark before "Matrem" is unclear and was left unmarked; the marks before "Pontifices", "immaculati agni" and "Dei" were assigned as h, i and k from the position of the notes in the margin. The first word of the note "Sacrar.ceremoniar" is smudged and was not read with certainty. The note "1.Pet.1.19." and the final "Act.20.28." are each set beside a different line from their markers. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, so the paragraph continues on the next page.
